title: R4B district (flat-roof envelope, ZR 23-422) - maximum building height
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the flat-roof envelope HEIGHT constraint for the exact R4B district per NYC Zoning Resolution section 23-422 (City of Yes, Last Amended 2024-12-05). The source gives R4B a single maximum building height (25 ft) with NO base-height / setback split, and no building-type condition ('In the district indicated, the maximum building height shall be 25 feet') - so ONLY max_building_height is emitted; a base height and a setback are NOT invented. R4B appears ONLY in section 23-422 (flat-roof); it has NO section 23-421 pitched-roof counterpart - this asymmetry is encoded exactly as sourced and never symmetrized. R4B is encoded SEPARATELY from R3-2/R4 (whose flat cap is 35 ft) and from every 23-421 pitched variant - no dimension is inherited (R4B's 25 ft flat BUILDING height is NOT the same construct as the 23-421 25 ft PERIMETER-WALL height). NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: R4B In the district indicated, the maximum building height shall be 25 feet.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability equals R4B (via in_set); R3-2/R4/R4A/R4-1 and every other district are NOT matched (visible not_applicable).

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.commercial_overlays[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.special_districts[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: historic_district
inputs.description: True iff the lot is in a designated Historic District (section 23-426); when a caller supplies true -> professional_review_required.

outputs.name: max_building_height
outputs.description: Maximum building height (ft) for R4B. Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result. No base-height/setback split exists for R4B in the source.

parameters.name: building_height_ft
parameters.note: R4B maximum building height 25 ft (section 23-422). Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

exceptions.description: A commercial overlay may modify residence-district height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
A mapped special district may modify height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
In a designated Historic District the height may be constrained (section 23-426); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
The source gives R4B only a maximum building height (25 ft) with no base-height/setback split; a base height and a setback are not invented.
Building height is measured ABOVE THE BASE PLANE (section 23-42); the base-plane determination is a separate professional input.
R4B is flat-only: it has NO section 23-421 pitched-roof counterpart. This asymmetry is encoded as sourced and never symmetrized (no pitched envelope is invented for R4B).

The section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site / qualifying-senior-housing increase and the section 23-425 large-site modification are conditional alternatives not modeled here (A2 gaps, geography/eligibility dependent).
